Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  If you don't trash 1 [SW] trait card, you can't use the part after "after" in this card's [Main] effect to place this card in the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: ＜Use Req. ([SW] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] By trashing 1 [SW] trait card from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞. After, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your [SW] trait Digimon are played, ＜Delay＞.
